MbedTLS.notes: Apache-2.0 option selected from Mbed TLS/TF-PSA dual Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later offer; retain complete license text and embedded permissive notices. Exact regular files are verified before configure and by source closure; 147 symlinks solely under unused PQC test/example directories are intentionally not materialized. No upstream source changes, test/example targets, transitive downloads, package fallback, shared crypto libraries or public TLS types. Config uses fixed16384-byte record buffers; runtime restricts TLS1.3, authenticated server certificates, P256 and AES128GCM/SHA256. No tickets/resumption/early data; account auth belongs to M02b. TCP head-of-line behavior is an explicit provisional local foundation limit.
